# 804re.com

> Michael Hottman's ("804michael") personal real estate practice, part of Malcolm Real Estate, a family-owned brokerage headquartered in Ashland, VA, serving Hanover County, Henrico County, the City of Richmond, Chesterfield, Powhatan, Goochland, and Caroline counties. Seller-focused representation, with deep experience protecting home buyers — especially first-time buyers — from costly mistakes in the purchase process.

Michael Hottman has been licensed in real estate since age 19, grew up in the family brokerage, and also spent years in IT, graphic design, and as a Licensed Professional Counselor before re-licensing in 2012. Spent nearly a decade at one of Central Virginia's largest real estate offices, where the role centered on keeping agents and clients out of contract trouble and training agents on how to correctly use the residential purchase agreement. That background now shapes a practice built around protecting sellers from inexperienced buyer's agents, and protecting buyers — particularly first-timers — from mistakes that cost them money or the deal itself.

## Core pages

- [Home](https://804re.com/): Michael Hottman, broker with Malcolm Real Estate, serving Ashland, Hanover County, Henrico County, the City of Richmond, Chesterfield, Powhatan, Goochland, and Caroline counties. Seller-focused representation with a track record protecting first-time and repeat buyers.
- [Ashland VA Real Estate](https://804re.com/ashland): Homes for sale in Ashland VA, free home valuation, school zone info, and hyper-local market insights for the Center of the Universe.
- [Hanover County VA Real Estate](https://804re.com/hanover): Homes for sale across Hanover County VA, covering neighborhoods from Ashland to Mechanicsville, plus award-winning school district guidance.
- [Glen Allen VA Real Estate](https://804re.com/glen-allen): Homes for sale in Glen Allen VA, including Short Pump, West Broad Village, and top-rated Henrico County schools.
- [Mechanicsville VA Real Estate](https://804re.com/mechanicsville): Homes for sale in Mechanicsville VA, an established, high-value Hanover County community with easy interstate access.
- [Draw Your Search Area](https://804re.com/map-search): Interactive map tool for buyers to draw their ideal search area across Ashland, Hanover County, or Glen Allen and send it directly to Michael.
- [Determine Your Budget](https://804re.com/determine-your-budget): What you can actually afford in Central Virginia, using live weekly mortgage rates, with a county lookup for local tax and insurance figures.
- [Cash to Buy a Home](https://804re.com/cash-to-buy-a-home): The real up-front cost of buying beyond the purchase price - earnest money, inspections, appraisal, closing costs and prepaids, in plain language.
- [Seller Net Sheet](https://804re.com/seller-net-sheet): Estimate what a seller actually walks away with at closing after commission, taxes, payoff and concessions.
- [Home Value Estimate](https://804re.com/home-value-estimate): Free, no-signup home valuation request for Ashland, Hanover County, Glen Allen and Mechanicsville.
- [Hanover Farmstand Trail](https://804re.com/farmstand): A community map of farm stands, produce stands and roadside markets across Hanover County and Ashland VA.
